scenarios.name: Retain Watch audio only with consent
scenarios.given: a Watch recording arrives on iPhone
scenarios.when: transcription finishes with Save audio recordings on or off
scenarios.then: opt-in retains playable audio and opt-out removes the inbox copy

manual.reason: Paired-device capture and reconnection need a real Watch and iPhone; simulator acceptance is separate.
steps: With retention enabled, record while disconnected and reconnect; verify the recording transfers once and plays on iPhone.
Repeat with retention disabled and verify transcription without retained playback audio.
Keep Watch excluded from distribution until the #181 physical-device gate passes.

scenarios.name: Queue finalized chunks once
scenarios.given: a Watch recording contains finalized and active chunks
scenarios.then: only finalized chunks not already queued are selected

scenarios.name: Ignore duplicate Watch delivery
scenarios.given: a chunk has already been accepted on iPhone

scenarios.name: Reject remote start while phone is inactive
scenarios.given: the iPhone app is not active
scenarios.when: the Watch requests a remote start
